rulings.decision: Disable/hide project-shell refresh unless a single current process target exists; continue implementation to make UI truthful.
rulings.rationale: Project-shell rehydration should only be offered when ownership of the working copy is unambiguous. This keeps the UI truthful, matches the backend constraint already present in the runtime-backed refresh path, avoids presenting an action that immediately fails, and defers any cross-process project-level target selection to a later explicitly designed story.
